tonePolicy.note: Published broad citation transcription, not acoustic measurements. Author explicitly reports more narrowly realized values223/112/21 etc but chooses24/113/31 for readability. No substitution with measured values. No sandhi is computed.
tonePolicy.normalization: Read the printed syllabary onset row+rhyme header+tone letter. Convert the printed tone letter with the article’s explicit numeric key. PUA extraction is preserved in the ignored PDF/text, never treated as valid UnicodeIPA. The printed zero-onset row marker Ø is omitted from the syllable, not interpreted as a vowel or glottal stop.
